_schema.description: Tag-60 engine-version-drift scanner allowlist (extended Tag-62 for the 0.5.3-rc1 → 0.5.3 final-bump rc1-suffix-drop). Each entry declares a file path (repo-relative) and the legitimate stale-literal context. The scanner skips matches whose containing file matches an entry and whose match-category is in 'categories'. The categories are: 'historical-manifest' (the file IS a frozen manifest of an older version), 'historical-pin-pack-reference' (the file is a per-version verifier that intentionally references its own manifest filename), 'release-notes-negative-assertion' (the test asserts the stale literal is NOT present and therefore must mention it), 'historical-migration-narrative' (free-form prose in docstrings describing past migrations), 'v907-baseline-pin' (the JSON baseline file pins historical hash inputs that contain version strings), 'manifest-historical-comment' (single-line comment in production code referencing a past version transition for narrative purposes only — never an active version claim).
